answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 191 Country: United Kingdom Title: What is the ruling of having azan or quran recitation as your mobile/cell ringtone? Question: What is the ruling of having azan or quran recitation as your mobile/cell ringtone? Answer ID: 191 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 189/M=185/M) It is not good to have Azan or Quran recitation as ringtone on one?s mobile. It lessens the importance of Zikr-ul-Allah, therefore it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
